runners_data.name: Masai Angel
runners_data.note: Held-up style from the Fahey yard, Harry Russell aboard; best Southwell sim-going run was a win in 1 from 5, though no wins or places in similar going otherwise — needs a troubled pace to find late daylight.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, Masai Angel at least steps into the stall from draw 1 carrying 134 lb with distance and going experience to call upon, though two consecutive unplaced efforts dampen enthusiasm for a gelding ranked sixth of twelve.

runners_data.name: Rogue Federation
runners_data.note: A finisher by nature who tends to fade when asked for effort too soon, William Pyle rides for the Frost stable whose 14-day record is flat (0/8); placed in the field's midfield section because the rear is over-subscribed with true hold-up types, tempering its prospects meaningfully.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last three starts and ranked bottom of the field on our figures, Rogue Federation faces a stiff ask here; he has run over today's trip and going before, and 39 days between runs leaves him reasonably fresh, but little else in his recent profile invites confidence.

runners_data.name: Yes Waliim
runners_data.note: Winning form on Fibresand at 7f (1 from 10 in similar going) is the key stat, and a headgear note (p) may sharpen focus; Oliver Hoodless (7) takes the ride, but this horse is a genuine hold-up runner squeezed into a mid-pack position — its role here is unlikely to be the one it needs.

runners_data.name: Based
runners_data.note: Won over 7f on Standard going and has multiple placed efforts in similar conditions, giving it the strongest AW credentials of the redistributed closers; Cieren Fallon is a major positive, though the horse operates from behind and the congested field limits how cleanly it can replicate that closing form.
runners_data.comment: Based shaped well when third two starts back and landed a win four starts back, showing he has the ability to compete at this level; he has run over today's trip and going, and at 131 lb the weight burden is his chief hurdle.

runners_data.name: Soul Warrior
runners_data.note: Has the visor on (v) and fades in the finish flag attached — a combination that rarely inspires confidence in a race with this much pace; Alex Jary (3) rides, Nigel Tinkler 14-day strike rate is 0/17, and its similar-going record of 0 wins 0 places from 9 runs paints a cautious picture.
runners_data.comment: Third three starts back but winless in his last five, Soul Warrior faces a stiff ask from 130 lb out of stall seven, though experience over today's trip and going and a 24-day turnaround leave him primed physically if that elusive improvement arrives.

runners_data.name: Great Success
runners_data.note: Blinkers fitted (b), runs for Scott Dixon (0/23 in 14 days) with Kieran O'Neill up, and has finished no better than fourth in its last six — the hold-up position it truly needs will be hard to exploit at the back of a 14-runner field.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last six starts and held up by a trainer yet to land a winner in 23 attempts over the past fortnight, Great Success faces stiff questions, though he has run over today's trip and going before and a rating of 59 offers a slim foothold.

runners_data.name: Golden Harvest
runners_data.note: Best placed third over 5f on Standard going, but subsequent outings at 6f and 7f have been weak; Dougie Costello is an experienced hand, though only 1 from 4 in similar going and a 39-day absence makes this a speculative each-way proposition at best.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last four starts and ranked near the foot of the field on our figures, Golden Harvest faces a stiff ask here; a third last time out offers the one crumb of encouragement, and he has run over today's distance and going before, returning after 39 days off.

runners_data.name: Zonnebloem
runners_data.note: 315-day absence is a significant concern and must be the headline — Sean Levey rides for Jessica Macey (1/3 in 14 days), and the limited form base of just three runs (all at 5f) raises questions over both fitness and the step to 6f.
runners_data.comment: Zonnebloem has been winless in her last three starts and returns after a 315-day absence, which is the primary concern; her third last time out is a slender positive, and she does have experience over today's trip and going, but she looks up against it from stall 12 on these figures.

runners_data.name: Lope Y Linda
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner for Tim Easterby, Sean Kirrane up, returning quickly on 9 days; only 1 from 15 in similar going conditions is a stark statistic, though on a flat 6f track with a rival to fight, it will at least ensure the pace is genuine and honest throughout.
runners_data.comment: Lope Y Linda showed she retains ability with a third two starts back, but has been unplaced on her latest outing and remains lightly taxed by an official mark of 53; she has run over today's trip and going, and the 128 lb burden from stall nine is the key query.

runners_data.name: Society Charm
runners_data.note: Peter Chapple-Hyam's front-runner returns from a 140-day break which is a real fitness question mark; Marco Ghiani is an able jockey but three runs of 6th, 7th, 7th do not inspire, and it must be considered whether it has the condition to lead and sustain after such a layoff.
runners_data.comment: Society Charm has been winless in her last three starts, finishing no better than sixth, and 140 days off the track does little to inspire confidence; she does have experience over today's trip and conditions, but her rating of 49 makes her hard to fancy against stronger rivals here.

runners_data.name: Surgeon Commander
runners_data.note: The highest-rated runner (OR 60) with three wins from 12 similar-going starts including course victories over 7f; Billy Loughnane is a strong booking, and although the horse is a hold-up type by style, it has the raw ability to overcome a modest closing position if the pace shapes up perfectly.
runners_data.comment: Surgeon Commander won last time out and, with experience of today's distance and going, conditions pose no concern; carrying 135 lb from stall two, he arrives after 67 days off but his form reads well enough to make him a confident pick here.

runners_data.name: Taaklam
runners_data.note: Prominent style (P) is the natural fit for this race shape — Tom Kiely-Marshall (5) rides for Harriet Bethell, and the horse's placed record from the front (0W3P) in similar going over 6f at Southwell makes it the most tactically placed runner in the field.
runners_data.comment: Taaklam rates highest among these twelve rivals on our figures and has experience of both today's trip and conditions, making him a strong contender on paper, though he is winless in his last five starts and will need to find improvement to finally break through.

runners_data.name: Harlequin Bay
runners_data.note: Placed twice at Southwell (2nd and 3rd in similar going), which is the strongest piece of track-specific evidence in the field alongside Surgeon Commander; Jack Garritty rides for the Fahey yard (7/47 in 14 days — a solid strike rate), and the hold-up profile here is genuine rather than redistributed.
runners_data.comment: Harlequin Bay has shown he can mix it at this level, finishing third and second in recent starts, and he has run over today's distance and going before; the main concern is that he has been winless in his last five starts and must bounce back from two unplaced efforts.

runners_data.name: Love Alive
runners_data.note: Luke Morris partners this John Butler-trained hold-up runner; has placed form at 5f and 6f on similar going (1W1P from 13 runs), and at OR 59 is not without ability, though a finishing position in a 14-runner handicap will demand the clearest of passages.

races.paceDynamic: Lope Y Linda and Society Charm are the two confirmed front-runners in this 14-runner 6f handicap on Standard Fibresand at Southwell, and with both likely to press for the early lead, this will be a genuinely contested pace rather than a solo soft-pedal. That honest, competitive gallop from the front means the race shape will be set hard from the gates, with the principals fighting for position through the first two furlongs and sustaining a frank tempo into the home straight. Taaklam is the one prominent-type with natural early position and will be best placed to track the pace without over-committing, while Surgeon Commander from a hold-up style will need the leaders to have done enough damage. The field holds more true hold-up horses than the map can accommodate at the rear — Rogue Federation, Yes Waliim, Based, Soul Warrior, Great Success, Golden Harvest, and Zonnebloem are all genuine closers squeezed into a midfield depiction, with Lope Y Linda and Society Charm most likely to actually secure the front positions. A genuinely contested pace over 6f on this flat, fair surface favours horses who can travel prominently in behind the speed and pick up cleanly — the prominent tracker profile is the one to side with.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Contested, Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Lope Y Linda and Society Charm fight for the early lead and sustain a genuine gallop, a prominent horse travelling just off the pace lands in the ideal position.
scenarios.body: Taaklam, travelling in second or third with cover, gets a clean slingshot run into the straight and the honest tempo ensures the front two have done enough work to be caught; horses who pressed but conserved a little energy arrive with a decisive late kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Two Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners gets a soft lead through the early furlongs with the other dropping away, a front-runner can dictate a more controlled pace and prove hard to peg back.
scenarios.body: Lope Y Linda or Society Charm controls the tempo in a race where the other cracks early, allowing the leader to coast into the straight with energy in reserve; a flat, fair track without significant bias means there is no surface penalty for racing prominently.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Closers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace burns so hot that the front two genuinely tie each other up and the field bunches behind, a true closer who threads through traffic could snatch it late.
scenarios.body: Surgeon Commander has the class and course form to benefit if the closing run materialises, and Harlequin Bay has prior placed form at Southwell suggesting he handles the track; note that many of the mapped midfielders are redistributed hold-up types whose actual closing ability is tempered by the congested midfield.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, No Run Through
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses all fail to sustain their effort and there is significant trouble in running in a 14-runner field, a horse that gets the clearest passage wins regardless of style.
scenarios.body: Masai Angel, held up wide by Harry Russell, could be the one to find daylight in a scrambled finish; Love Alive has shown some placed form at sprint trips and Luke Morris will look for a clean path if the inside becomes congested.

watchPoints.text: Society Charm has been off 140 days and is a confirmed front-runner — if it fails to stride out early, the planned two-horse pace battle may not materialise, altering the entire race shape.

With seven genuine hold-up horses redistributed into the mapped midfield, serious crowding is likely in the straight at the 2f pole — watch for Surgeon Commander and Harlequin Bay having to switch wide to find room.

Taaklam is the only natural prominent tracker in the field and will be heavily sought after for that position behind the front two — if it gets shuffled back early by the jostling of a 14-runner field, its tactical advantage disappears.

Lope Y Linda runs on just 9 days — monitor market moves and paddock condition; a quick turnaround for a horse without a win or place in 15 similar-going starts could flag trainer intent or alternatively a horse returning beneath its peak.

Zonnebloem's 315-day absence makes it effectively an unknown quantity on fitness grounds — Sean Levey's judgment of how to deploy it in the early stages will be telling, but its form base is too thin to rely on.
